variants.title: Superconductor Tc by four-probe: a niobium-type film (illustrative)
variants.sample: Niobium-type film, Tc about 9 K (unsourced / illustrative)
variants.method: four-probe R against T, zero field and applied field
variants.unknown: Tc and the residual resistance ratio
variants.note: A low-Tc metal film: the transition is sharp (0.04 K) and a field of 0.1 T already moves Tc by a fraction of a kelvin. Tc, Bc2 and the shape are illustrative.

source.title: Unsourced / illustrative sample constants
source.note: Tc about 9 K is the order of magnitude for niobium; the exact numbers here are chosen for the lab, not looked up.
